integrity: The proof gives all-dimensional results; an independent exact finite checker tests ranks and Gram products for cycle orders four through seven.
scientific_limitations: Inherited Euclidean metric, unweighted cycles of length at least four, uniform sampling of distinct ridges; no assertion for general graphs, other metrics, or weighted sampling. Global literature priority unverified.
title: A logarithmic limiting law for dihedral angles of cycle graphical zonotopes
